title: FlexLine Late Fee Tenure Share
content:
| Age of the FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line on the booking date | Late-fee share |
|---|---|
| 48 whole calendar months or more | 0.90 |
| 24 whole calendar months or more, fewer than 48 | 0.95 |
| fewer than 24 whole calendar months | 1.00 |

The tenure share follows the age of the line from its open date: 48 months or more give 0.90; 24 months or more but fewer than 48 give 0.95; a younger line gives 1.00. The share multiplies the late fee as figured, before the fee is held to no more than the unpaid part of the minimum payment and rounded to the cent.

Whole calendar months are counted from the open date to the booking date, a month counting only once the booking date's day of the month reaches the open date's day of the month.

*Hypothetical boundary:* a line opened on 18 June is 23 months old on 17 June two years later and 24 months old on 18 June two years later, so its share moves from 1.00 to 0.95 on that day; a 25.00 USD figured fee at 0.95 is 23.75 USD before the cap and rounding.
